notes.title: Major Update: Prologue, Progression, Justice – 1.08
notes.notes: [h1]We’re back. And with a bang. Update 1.08.[/h1][p]This is the most significant demo update yet: laying the foundation for core mechanics, expanding the lore, and making the game more alive and intriguing.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171201/7a322f8eb45e9c388f7fff54659a38be7fe3e872.png"][/img][/h3][h3]New location – Prologue[/h3][p]Start your journey in the underground prison of Dummort – where it all began. Explore the eerie cells, uncover how you became part of this world. Now when you start a new game, choose: begin with the Arena or dive into the Prologue.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]English localization and voice‑over[/h3][p]We’ve improved the translation and added English voice acting in the Prologue scenes—both main dialogue and ambient lines.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Progression & Skills system[/h3][p]Now you can develop your character:[/p][p]– Earn experience from actions, combat, and quests[/p][p]– Spend it at teachers for skill points[/p][p]– Unlock your build with 15 skills, each with 5 mastery tiers—your freedom.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Justice & NPCs[/h3][p]– No safe zones: weapons can be drawn anywhere.[/p][p]– NPCs react to illegal actions and can fight back.[/p][p]– Loot fallen enemies.[/p][p]– New Arena characters and quests: Sabretooth & Murky.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Inventory & Crafting[/h3][p]– Equipment now has durability—repair at workbenches.[/p][p]– Expanded crafting: new recipes, tools, upgrades.[/p][p]– Improved throwing system.[/p][p]– Quick‑item slots depend on your bag’s quality.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Mini‑games[/h3][p]– Dice Poker – start your path to underground poker legend![/p][p]– Coin Flip – your chance to get a trader discount.[/p][p]– Persuasion – a small mini‑game unlocking new NPC interaction options.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]And Many More Improvements[/h3][p]We squashed countless bugs, enhanced UI & dialogue, updated NPC appearances to fit lore, and made combat more responsive.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.01 – 1.05: New Features, Balancing, and Optimizations
notes.notes:
We are excited to present the latest update, which brings a host of changes, improvements, and fixes. Here’s what’s new in Patch [u]1.01 – 1.05[/u]:

[b]— New Content and Mechanics:[/b]
A new enemy, the Raptor, has been added to the game, along with a new player ability system that will impact combat and other aspects of gameplay.
Gold and silver coins have been introduced, affecting the in-game economy. You will now collect and spend different types of currency, adding depth to the reward and trade systems.
The lockpicking mini-game has been reworked, making it more challenging but far more engaging. Additionally, kick mechanics have been updated: kicks can now be incorporated into combos, and transitioning from kicks to weapon attacks is smoother.

[b]— Optimization and Balancing:[/b]
We’ve significantly improved game performance, rebalanced damage and health levels, and adjusted enemy behavior. For example, ratmen no longer phase through walls. Arena wave balancing has also been updated.

[b]— Interface and Settings:[/b]
The interface has been updated with revamped icons and tooltips. HUD elements now disappear when the player’s health and stamina are full. We’ve also introduced an alternative HUD style.
New difficulty settings have been added, along with inventory filters and enhanced dialog and tooltip logic.

[b]— Bug Fixes:[/b]
Several critical bugs have been fixed, including item duplication, interface issues, and stamina-related problems. Quest fixes, save logic improvements, and NPC behavior have also been addressed.
The skull tile at the Arena exit has been rotated for smoother passage, and softlock and peaceful zone issues have been resolved.

notes.title: The First Steps of Step Into the Dark
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, World![/b]
It’s the first thing we’d like to print.
Looks like our first code, that we can see on the Steam page. However, it’s our first strokes on this page indeed. And all our team likes to welcome everybody here! 
First of all, we want to say:
""Thank you all for downloading and installing the demo of Step Into The Dark! (SITD)"
There were a lot of feedback we already received. Thank you very much for that! Your feedback and support inspire us to make the game much better! 
Now we try our best to take into account your suggestions, comments and impressions. We do much to improve the experience that you can gain in our game. And we hope, you could find some cool things for yourself in our little world.
As many people could see, we have already done a lot of work. To date, we have released several patches that improve the game and take into account some of your feedback. And we will continue to improve the demo until we reach the planned results. Our approach may seem unconventional - we're tweaking the demo version as if it were a real release. But we all are OK, don't worry.  It's because for us demo is like a real release - it's our first project, and we definitely want to give it all that we can. This is all for your, friends. I will give you all the details of the patches at the end of the text.
Right now, I will tell you about our future plans.
Today we are finishing another one patch, that contains some cool innovations that I won't talk about yet. And it’s not the last one. You will see everything in the near future. Just stay tuned - we will announce everything here! And it is not the last one patch! Be ready!

You may have also noticed that we've changed the release date to Q4 2026. That's right. It was a really big and even brave decision for us. There are а several reasons for this. First, we will move to Unreal Engine 5 (Now, it’s 4). Second, we got some financials offers, that make us believe we will able to do SITD better. We a planning to go to the whole product cycle in the incoming year. So, we want to realize much bigger & beautiful world, than you can see it today. We want you to enjoy our work, so we make this big decision. We hope it is good news for you.
Today, we a really small team. But we really in love with making games. Hope you'll follow our progress. We're not saying goodbye. Light Stone Games at your service!

Oh, yeah… Wish you a Happy New Year!
